params.body:
## Summary

The Google map in the footer and on the location page now follows the brand: grey with a slight petrol tint, and the orange pin from the logo on top of the searched address.

- Both embeds go through one partial (`partials/map.blade.php`) with height and zoom as parameters.
- A CSS filter on the iframe greys and tints the map. An embed does not accept a map style, and the Maps JavaScript API would need a key and billing; the filter needs neither.
- The embed always centres on the searched address, so the brand pin is placed at the centre of the frame, above Google's own marker.

Checked on the location page in a headless browser; the footer map is lazy-loaded and uses the same partial.

## After merge

Deploy; `npm run build` is part of the Forge deploy script.
